.@JensenHuang's visit comes as @FirebirdCloudAI and Kazakhtelecom expand NVIDIA-powered computing infrastructure, with Firebird planning a Kazakhstan lab to help local startups and researchers build on it.

See what’s taking shape in Kazakhstan: https://t.co/cqwtgiFOm2 https://t.co/lSmQ8NbDkp

Our CEO @JensenHuang met the next generation of AI builders in Astana. 🇰🇿

At https://t.co/oUc467MNRz, he spent time with students and startups and joined Deputy Prime Minister @Zhaslan_Madiyev to discuss Kazakhstan’s AI future. https://t.co/SLQ6owF7Kx
